details.groundedness_reasoning:

2. Citation [6] names the four champions racing: Verstappen, Hamilton, Alonso, and Norris. Of these, the sources show consecutive championship wins for Verstappen, Hamilton, and Alonso, but do not show Norris as a consecutive-title winner.
3. Thus the supplied passages do not support the gold target count of 4; the sources support only three distinct overlapping drivers. The gold target is therefore not fully grounded.
